brief.note: Manpower and Semtech join on an earnings miss and an analyst day; the AI names bounced.

candidates.name: ManpowerGroup Inc.
candidates.business: Places temporary and permanent staff for employers through Manpower and Experis brands
candidates.cause: Third-quarter revenue of $4.8bn missed forecasts, fourth-quarter guidance disappointed, and the company announced a chief executive handover at the same time.
candidates.right: The labour market turns and staffing demand recovers while the dividend holds at 3%
candidates.wrong: Hiring stays weak, Europe drags and the new chief resets expectations lower again

candidates.name: Semtech Corporation
candidates.business: Makes analog chips for data centre connectivity and internet-of-things devices
candidates.cause: At its data centre analyst day investors balked at the reliance on AI demand, pricing pressure, debt and acquisition risk; Northland cut the stock to Hold.
candidates.right: Data centre revenue compounds as promised and the multiple is earned over the next two years
candidates.wrong: AI orders slow, pricing erodes and a 100x trailing multiple has far further to fall

candidates.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
candidates.business: Rents Nvidia GPU capacity to AI developers from its own data centres
candidates.cause: Yields on its 2032 bonds neared 15% as investors balked at debt-funded AI expansion, and Gartner warned many neocloud providers will fail by 2030.
candidates.right: AI demand keeps the contracts full and CoreWeave refinances before the interest burden bites
candidates.wrong: Financing costs outrun contract revenue and the debt leaves little for shareholders

candidates.name: Perpetua Resources Corp.
candidates.business: Developing a US gold project; no production or revenue yet
candidates.cause: Gold and silver prices fell hard after hot US inflation data, and pre-production gold developers with no revenue dropped furthest of all.
candidates.right: Gold steadies and the project advances toward permits with analyst targets far above the price
candidates.wrong: Gold keeps falling and a pre-production developer needs to raise money at low prices
